يفتحلن (form VIII)
# يَفْتَحِلْنَ (yaftaḥilna) /jaf.ta.ħil.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# يُفْتَحَلْنَ (yuftaḥalna) /juf.ta.ħal.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
